ioping_target.description: Target directory, file, or device to monitor.

ioping_count.description: Stop after count requests. 0 means infinite.

ioping_size.description: Request size. Supports suffixes like k, m, g, sector, page.

ioping_work_size.description: Working set size. Supports suffixes like k, m, g, sector, page. Empty means default.

ioping_interval.description: Time between requests. Supports suffixes like s, ms, us, ns.

ioping_warmup.description: Ignore first count requests in statistics.

ioping_batch.description: Batch mode. Be quiet and print final statistics.

ioping_rate_limit.description: Rate limit in count per second. Supports suffixes k, m, g, t.

ioping_speed_limit.description: Speed limit in size per second. Supports suffixes k, m, g.

ioping_min_time.description: Minimal valid request time. Supports suffixes s, ms, us, ns.

ioping_max_time.description: Maximum valid request time. Supports suffixes s, ms, us, ns. Empty means no limit.

ioping_time_fmt.description: Print current time format string (strftime). Empty for default.

ioping_print_count.description: Print raw statistics for every count requests. Supports suffixes k, m, g, t.

ioping_print_interval.description: Print raw statistics for every time. Supports suffixes s, ms, us, ns.

ioping_linear.description: Use sequential operations rather than random.

ioping_keep.description: Keep and reuse temporary working file.
